description: ERC20 token balance of any wallet on Ethereum, Base, Arc or BNB Chain: raw balance, decimals, symbol and balance in token units, with the block read. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: evm_token_balance
